name: Unity USD
oneLiner: UUSD is Anything Labs's BSC-based protocol dollar minted against managed stablecoin and crypto collateral, with limited public mechanism documentation.
collateral: BSC stablecoin and crypto collateral managed by the UUSD protocol
pegMechanism: Protocol-issued dollar token using managed collateral and liquidity incentives to hold the USD peg

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: UUSD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: Unity USD (UUSD) is an upgradeable Ownable proxy ERC-20 on BSC operated by Anything Labs; live reads resolve the token owner to a 4/6 Safe that can mint/burn directly and controls the proxy-admin ownership chain.

controls.label: UUSD owner Safe
controls.evidence: BSC owner() returned this Safe; Safe Transaction Service returned threshold 4, six owners, no enabled modules, and the zero guard. The owner can mint/burn directly under the UUSD implementation.

controls.label: UUSD proxy-admin ownership chain
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot returned this contract; owner() returned 0x2D49CB4194dFa42d711699a87C10C6BbC05d94b6, whose owner() resolves to the same 4/6 Safe.

review.evidence: BSC reads show the UUSD token is an upgradeable proxy with Safe owner control over mint/burn and a proxy-admin ownership chain controlled by the same Safe; Anything Labs markets UUSD as reserve-backed for an AI-agent economy, but reserve attestation remains unresolved.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Owner-controlled upgradeable proxy confirmed from BscScan; the actual mint authorization path and collateral backing are undocumented, so the issuer-direct/owner-controlled classification is the best-supported reading rather than a fully opaque unknown.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve whether a distinct off-chain reserve process backs issued UUSD supply.
